note: B25 Office de tourisme, first floor: the orientation room (La salle d'orientation), camera at the double door from the gallery. Pale lemon-cream walls with compass charts, slate-blue and white tiled floor with a navy floor compass; landmark: the round stone orientation table on its pivot. Feminine LEFT: ostrich holding a picture card in its beak while a puppy folds the paper plane it shows (instruction); explorer cat pointing the way (indication); ant scout with a compass turning the map (orientation); tall porter on tiptoe reaching a hat box on a high shelf (portée). Masculine RIGHT: grandmother teacher ringing a hand bell as rabbits line up in a row (rang); sheep in a cowboy hat in a tub of suds on the lower-left arm of the floor compass (sud-ouest); duck scrubbing her nest in suds on the lower-right arm (sud-est); inventor giving a thumbs-up by his pulley contraption (dispositif). Exits: double door left -> gallery R_world_02; open French windows back right -> telescope balcony R_abs_space_02_z2; zoom on the orientation table -> R_abs_space_02_z1. Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p3).
